summary: REPAIR #8 (serpentine visual direction) verification: PASS on all critical sub-tests. List-view band assignments across L2..L13 match spec exactly. flex-row-reverse and ml/mr indent classes flip correctly per band. Deep L13 note reachable. IDB byte-identical before/after UI expansion, view swap, and reload (Repair #1 invariant intact). Test-8 and Test-9 regression checks pass. Zero console errors, zero page errors. Grid-view (V4) could not exercise NestedSubGroup because default grid+group_by_category flattens all descendants of Work into a single tile row (no data-hierarchy-level nodes render); this is orthogonal to Repair #8, not a regression. Two intended source files present (service-worker CACHE_NAME=v170, NestedSubGroup.jsx Repair #8 block); git tree clean before AND after test run (no source drift).
action_items: Info (not a bug): Grid view + Group-by-category flattens Work's descendants into a tile row, so serpentine cannot be verified visually in that mode. If future testing wants to assert grid-mode serpentine, the app needs a documented drilldown path that mounts NestedSubGroup in icon view (V4 expectation in the request assumed such a path — none is currently reachable from default seeded state).
critical_code_review_comments: Repair #8 implementation in NestedSubGroup.jsx (lines 69-70, 106, 108-109, 122) is clean, presentational-only, and correctly derives hierarchyLevel and inReverseBand from depth. Data attributes data-hierarchy-level and data-serpentine-band make automated verification trivial. Recommend keeping.
Repair #3 marker is absent from the source (was previously acknowledged as 'flag for future review' in iteration_82). Not introduced by Repair #8; pre-existing.

Minor: storageService.js:245 getTemplates uses localforage.iterate with a callback that pushes and implicitly returns undefined (correct). If future contributors accidentally return a truthy value, iteration will stop early. Consider replacing with keys()+getItem loop for defensive safety.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on applicable sub-tests (V1,V2,V3,V5,V6,V7,V8,V9,V10); V4 not-applicable due to grid view flattening

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral IDB seeding via CDN-injected localforage: 15-note deep-chain (L1..L13 under Work→…→Final + 2 baseline) for V1-V7; 5-note test-pack-8 (t1..t5) for V8; 12-note diverse dataset (u1-u2 uncat + w1-w3 Work + wa1-wa2 Work/Alpha + pht1-pht2 Personal/Home/Tasks + fp1-fp3 Fitness pack) for V9. Settings persisted under 'app_settings' key.
context_for_next_testing_agent: IMPORTANT: The app stores settings as a SINGLE object under key 'app_settings' inside the 'settings' store (not individual keys). Use PATCH pattern: read app_settings, spread + patch, write back. To read notes from IDB via injected localforage, use keys()+getItem loop — do NOT use iterate() with a push() callback because push() returns a truthy length and stops iteration early (false-positive small counts). localforage must be re-injected via add_script_tag after EVERY page.reload. In grid+group_by_category mode, a top-level category expands into a FLAT tile grid of all descendant notes; NestedSubGroup does not render, so [data-hierarchy-level] queries return empty in that view (this is not a Repair #8 bug, it's the grid view design). Category top-level toggle testid is [data-testid="category-toggle-<name>"]; nested toggles are [data-testid="nested-subgroup-toggle-<label>"].
rca of the issue: N/A — no issue found for Repair #8. Verification results: L2/L3/L4=forward, L5/L6/L7/L8=reverse, L9/L10/L11/L12=forward, L13=reverse. flex-row-reverse present on reverse-band headers only. ml-4 mr-0 on reverse wrappers, ml-0 mr-4 on forward wrappers. Data model unchanged across all UI interactions.
